test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Distinguished
solution:
The correct answer is 'acclaimed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'distinguished' means 'dignified and noble in appearance or manner'.
 
• likewise, the meaning of acclaimed is enthusiastically praised

So the appropriate similar word to distinguished is acclaimed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** let's look at the other word meanings;

 
• **Practical **means being effective in real circumstances; feasible,

 
 
• For eg:- That's not practical.
 
 
 
• **Lowly **means low in status or importance; humble,
 
 
• For eg:- Don't think so lowly of yourself.
 
 
 
• **Ordinary** means with no special or distinctive features; normal,
 
 
• For eg:- He is just an ordinary person.
